This is not entertainment. Canada has lost more than 100,000 people to failures the public record already documents — policy, neglect, capture, and refusal to enforce. We name sources so the living can still verify, and so the dead are not reduced to spectacle.

LIRIL walks the open record in order: government publications, court files, Hansard, open data. Eleven acts · multi-hour playthrough. Pause when you need to. Resume tomorrow. Jump by act. Film is atmosphere under narration — primary sources remain the proof.
